tagline: A living form, shaped by us.
intro: Touch it. Change it. Leave something behind.

draw_scar.label: Draw Scar
draw_scar.hint: Drag across the body to leave a vein.

seed_letter.label: Seed Letter
seed_letter.hint: Plant a single letter. Watch it become anatomy.

feed_word.label: Feed Word
feed_word.hint: Offer a word. The body interprets its form.

add_limb.label: Add Limb
add_limb.hint: Give it a new direction to grow.

feed_mass.label: Feed Mass
feed_mass.hint: Add living volume to one region.

heal.label: Heal
heal.hint: Ease a wound in this area.

corrupt.label: Corrupt
corrupt.hint: Disturb the tissue with a new mark.
